_exports_note: ARCO_OPS_PLAN §B1 — dev tooling (Vite serve, `tsx --conditions development`) resolves the live .ts source; bare `node dist/index.js` (production / `arco service`) and `vite build` get the compiled dist. Without this, the compiled server crashes on boot resolving @arco/shared to a .ts file. `types`→src keeps tsc (moduleResolution: bundler) typechecking against live source.
